title: [pagination]: error message displays stalled value
body:
Hi,
just to let you know that the documentation for cssClasses for the pagination widget is not correct.

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/afc507c276fac38c0371f7fbb704383115631046/src/widgets/pagination/pagination.js#L92

The documentation say the parameter is named `itemNextPage` and in the code it's `nextPageItem`, same for `itemPreviousPage` which is `previousPageItem`.

I think you may have others typo like these.
